answer: The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, unlocked only after continuous uptime, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. What survives to the mesa is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Every claim climbs the orchard of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the garden re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
